notes: Acceptance criteria for D15-2..D15-G. D15-2 and D15-3 are PASS with committed evidence; D15-3R is PASS (scripted keyless provider); D15-4 is PARTIAL/BLOCKED with committed evidence (native continuable/fork seam qualified; child-crash and BYQ adapter-restart required items BLOCKED; host reboot NOT_RUN); D15-5 is PARTIAL/BLOCKED with committed evidence (real native persistent terminal for four client-side fault rows and all cross-checks; adapter-restart and dsh-runtime-restart required items BLOCKED because native sessions are process-local and no BYQ TerminalAttachment wiring exists; host reboot NOT_RUN); D15-G is NO_GO (NOT-PASS) with committed evidence in docs/evidence/d15/d15-g/ because the four atomic required capabilities child-crash, BYQ adapter-restart, terminal adapter-restart and terminal DSH-runtime-restart did not pass; aggregate capabilities are derived display values and host reboot is an OPTIONAL limitation NOT_RUN, so neither decides the verdict. No criteria may be marked PASS without committed evidence. D15-2 PASS is FORMAT-LAYER migration evidence only. D15-3 PASS covers native persistence-layer session resume across a new OS process only. D15-3R is a scripted keyless service-boundary pass. R3_RESUME stays NO after D15-G; only a GO plus R3/R6 native-continuity evidence could reconsider it.

a GO is granted only when every required atomic capability is actually PASS; a required non-PASS forces NO_GO

every required non-PASS atomic capability is named as an actionable blocker; aggregate capabilities are derived and optional capabilities are limitations, never blockers; a GO does not authorize production cutover

the Proposed ADR-0082/0083 remain not accepted and not implemented
